Complaint scam. Plant AI does not show this trial subscription anywhere under your AppleID, on purpose I suspect. They’ve found a crack in Apple’s system so that they can scam all free 7-day trial users into paying for a year. It appears that Plant Parent set this up to be an in-app purchase instead of a proper subscription. I asked Apple - Apple can’t see it to cancel it for you, and later Apple won’t help cancel the charge when it comes on day 8 because it’s an “in-app purchase”. Plant Parent intentionally does not give any option to cancel anywhere in the app (I’ve read every line of every page, just like many others). If contacted (they only have an email, no phone etc), and you happen to get a response, they’ll apparently send you to iTunes(?!) to cancel it (no one can get this to work). In other words, once you start the 7-day trial, you’re paying for a year, unless you have luck disputing the charge with Apple (keep documentation), or later disputing the Apple charge with your credit card (documentation needed as well).

I strongly recommend filing a scam report with your AppleID with Apple. Surely Apple does not want this sort of behavior in its App Store.
